{{Quote|Rumored it is that some Wookiees are unhappy to be allied with the Republic. But too important this conference is to allow it to be disrupted by the Separatists.|[[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Incident on Kashyyyk" />}}
A '''conference''' was held by the native [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==The conference==
The security for the conference was over seen by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] was also present with him on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] to handle the [[Politics/Legends|politicians]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were aware that some [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] were becoming unhappy to be allied with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], but the conference was considered too important to be delayed.

All attendees of the conference, including the Wookiee [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], had to pass through a [[holoscanner]], which was monitored by a [[Unidentified Wookiee sergeant|Wookiee sergeant]], to check for weapons. A [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shield]] also protected the speakers against [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire from the audience.

Despite the security measures, one Wookiee, the decorated war hero [[General/Legends|General]] [[Attimun]], managed to sneak a dismantled explosive charge launcher through the scanner. When the conference started, he used the weapon to attack the speakers from the trees above the conference room. Kenobi successfully attacked and subdued the Wookiee before he could deal too much damage. Attimun was immediately arrested and later revealed to have become enraged with the Republic after the [[Death/Legends|death]] of his [[Attimun's family|family]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Incident on Kashyyyk" />
